metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 쿼터니언 ① 허수에서 회전과 역원까지
metadata.description:
회전을 저장할 네 숫자는 왜 필요할까요? 허수의 뜻과 평면 회전부터 출발해, 몸체의 방향을 나타내는 쿼터니언으로 이어갑니다. 같은 회전을 유지하면서 반각, 두 부호, 정규화와 역회전까지 차근차근 확인합니다. 두 편 중 첫 편으로, 다음 편에서는 순서가 있는 회전 합성과 벡터 회전을 계산합니다.

englishMetadata.title: Game Mathematics Part 2: Quaternions 1 — From Imaginary Numbers to Rotation and Inverses
englishMetadata.description:
Why do we need four numbers to store a rotation? We begin with imaginary numbers and planar rotation, then connect them to a quaternion describing body orientation. Keeping the same defined rotation, we examine half angles, two signs, normalization and reversal. This is the first of two lectures; the next computes ordered composition and vector rotation.

📚 Game Math PART2 course materials
YamYamWiki · Game Math PART2
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

40% actual gameplay and60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Overview: storing and reversing a rotation
01:30 What is an imaginary number?
02:02 Complex multiplication as planar rotation
02:45 From a plane to a 3D rotation axis
04:20 Four components are not four angles
05:44 Axis-angle and half angles
06:25 A worked half-angle example
08:55 Compose two quarter-turns
09:42 Two signs, one orientation
13:48 Length and conditions for normalization
14:28 Length, direction and normalization
17:18 Conjugate reverses a unit rotation
18:42 General inverse and squared norm
20:00 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.

YamYamCoding is a Korean game-programming channel covering DirectX, Unity, Unreal Engine and computer graphics.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Learn to design and implement real projects with guided feedback.
